hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Firstmate early handoff trigger, from this home's tracked Claude hook: about 4% of context is left before auto-compact (96000 of 100000 tokens). This follows the park-then-handoff action already queued for this session, which parks every open captain question first; with those parked, write your full session handoff now, before auto-compact: persist every open work record, decision, and piece of durable knowledge this session holds (the stow skill covers this), record the handoff with bin/fm-order.sh handoff --doc <handoff file>, then hand off to a successor and report that this session is ready to restart. Launch your successor with bin/fm-handoff-launch.sh <handoff file>. Run it with the Bash tool's run_in_background=true, because a foreground tool timeout cannot cover its setup plus the ten-minute protocol deadline, and collect the launcher's exit status and output before reporting readiness. It requires the successor to read the document, write its nonce-bound acknowledgement with bin/fm-handoff-ack.sh, and take the session lock before state/.handoff-successor clears this turn's gate. The successor confirms the handoff sha256 and stops on a mismatch. The lock transfers while this session is still alive, so do not wait for an external exit. The successor then runs bin/fm-session-start.sh. After verified transfer, end this turn and retire the predecessor session. If both attempts fail within ten minutes, the launcher emits handoff_failed; report that failure instead of claiming readiness. A failure with reason=unresolved is not final: a later handoff_ack with reason=lock_transferred for the same nonce means the transfer committed. Do not run /compact. This instruction fires once per session.
